definitions.explanation: A short form of {外務大臣|がいむだいじん}, the cabinet minister in charge of foreign affairs. Common in news headlines and reporting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日米|にちべい}→日米：13092_nichibei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{外相|がいしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{会談|かいだん}→会談：11542_kaidan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The Japanese and American foreign ministers held talks.

examples.japanese: {外相|がいしょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦{訪米|ほうべい}→訪米：22848_houbei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: The Foreign Minister is scheduled to visit the United States next week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{各国|かっこく}→各国：12055_kakkoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{外相|がいしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まって→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧⟦{国際|こくさい}{会議|かいぎ}→国際会議：28601_kokusaikaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: Foreign ministers from various countries gathered for an international conference.

notes:
An abbreviation of {外務大臣|がいむだいじん} formed with {相|しょう} (minister), the same element seen in ⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧ (prime minister) and {財務相|ざいむしょう} (finance minister). Used mainly in writing and headlines; in speech the full title is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {外相|がいしょう}⟦{会談|かいだん}→会談：11542_kaidan⟧: foreign ministers' talks
- ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{外相|がいしょう}: Japan's Foreign Minister
- {外相|がいしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as Foreign Minister
